messages.subject: iPlots on Mountain Lion
parts:
Greetings all…

I have managed to get Rattle to work (somewhat) on Mountain Lion, but ran into issues regarding iPlots.

I contacted someone familiar with the product and was informed the following:

"You can only use pilots from a multi-threaded Java session, e.g., JGR. Recent versions of OSX
no longer allow the use of AWT from a single-threaded program like R".

Now…if I read this correctly, Rattle no longer works on later versions of OSX. I have read where 
people have used Sys.setenv(NOAWT=1), but that seems not to work (or, if it does, there is
some sort of "secret handshake" needed to make it actually work).

If this is NOT true, I'd like to hear how anyone was able to successfully install iPlots on their
OSX box and successfully create the plots in Chapter 5 of Data Mining with Rattle and R.

Thanks in advance,
Joe
